claim: Cross-Domain Understanding / The Lock Mechanism Pattern: one equation, V = I x R, appears identically across domains, and locking one variable leaves two degrees of freedom you can feel ('one gives, the other takes away').

pieces.what: The gathered explorer built and laid in: lock one variable, drag another on log sliders, watch the third answer

The same three sliders reskinned as water, sound, light, labour — and the piece checks each mapping against its own physics. Light through an opaque medium falls off exponentially (Beer-Lambert), not as 1/R, so the test will likely show some analogies break; that finding goes home through the Deposit map
pieces.walks_up_from: the water pipe, the one analogy that holds
